summary.text: Gregg Hart was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 37th Assembly District.

paragraphs.text: His official biography says he has served the Santa Barbara community for more than 30 years as a planning commissioner, city council member, California coastal commissioner and Santa Barbara County supervisor.
Hart began his career as a legislative assistant to former Assemblymember Jack O'Connell and later was deputy executive director of the Santa Barbara County Association of Governments.
He grew up in Santa Barbara, graduated from Santa Barbara City College and the University of California, Santa Barbara, and for more than twenty years owned and operated Transitions Preschool.
